subject: VIP kickoff: rental pool + last-mile SOP for hybrid workshop
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, BlueWing Car Services <ops@bluewingcars.com>, Acme Workshops Events <events@acmeworkshops.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: VIP kickoff: rental pool + last-mile SOP for hybrid workshop

Team / BlueWing / Acme events —

We have a compact itinerary for the Aug 18–19 hybrid executive workshop. Goal: a low-friction arrival experience for 18 execs + 10 on-site facilitators across two venues: Main HQ and Satellite Loft. I attached a draft rental_pool_manifest.xlsx and pickup-window-matrix.pdf for reference.

High-level asks:
- Can BlueWing confirm capacity to provide 6 sedans (EV preferred), 2 SUVs, and 2 short-haul vans dedicated for VIP rotations (6am–9am windows on both days)?
- We need a rental-car buffer of 4 backup vehicles for last-minute changes (flight delays, extra attendees). Can Acme confirm a nearby vendor (rental counter or lot) that can hold that buffer?
- Marissa/Karthik: help map attendees to ride types and annotate who needs private cars vs shared shuttle.
- Lauren: parking ingress/egress plan at Satellite Loft — can we stage curbside 'VIP only' for 15 mins and a 2-car hold lane?

Operational constraints: tight arrival windows (most flights land 7:00–8:30am), valet curb at Main HQ is single-lane for 3 cars, and Satellite Loft has limited short-term stalls. We want a failover plan: if curb is full, drivers park at Lot B and use a 3-minute shuttle hop.

Please reply with confirmations/concerns by Tuesday EOD (Aug 3). If BlueWing needs a quick ops call, propose a 20-min slot Tues morning.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Program Lead, Events & Customer Ops
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachment stubs: rental_pool_manifest.xlsx (spreadsheet), pickup-window-matrix.pdf (PDF)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Workshops Events <events@acmeworkshops.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VIP kickoff: rental pool + last-mile SOP for hybrid workshop

Jordan — thanks, pushed a first-pass allocation into the manifest (see tab "allocations"). Quick notes: 

- Proposed split: 10 private cars (execs + keynotes), 4 shared sedans for multi-attendee transfers, 2 shuttle vans for speaker kits/AV carts.
- Flagged 4 people as "EV required" in the manifest — logistics team confirmed 6 EV-capable plugs near Lot B staging (30% surcharge if using EV drivers outside preferred fleet).
- Backup plan: I recommend we honor the 4 backup rental units as reserved with Acme's local partner (they can hold vehicles at counter with a credit card hold). Karthik, can you confirm which rental partner you prefer?
- Driver contacts: I added placeholder phone numbers and requested BlueWing to provide individual driver names for vetting (IDs required for access). We should require at least one driver per two VIPs for privacy.

Next steps: 
1) BlueWing to confirm driver roster + per-vehicle ETA buffer.
2) Acme to confirm rental vendor and hold policy for 4 vehicles.
3) Lauren to share Satellite Loft curb map (2-car hold lane) and Lot B coordinates.

If BlueWing is available, let's do a 20-min ops sync Tuesday 9:30–9:50am PT — I'll book a calendar hold.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Onsite Events Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: BlueWing Ops Team <ops@bluewingcars.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T08:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VIP kickoff: rental pool + last-mile SOP for hybrid workshop

Jordan / Marissa / team —

Thanks for the details and the manifest. Short answers up front: yes, BlueWing can cover the quantities requested for Aug 18–19. A few operational clarifications and proposals: 

1) Fleet & drivers: We can allocate 6 sedans (3 EVs), 2 SUVs, 2 vans and keep 4 backup warm vehicles on standby at Lot B. Drivers will have printed manifest and police-verified IDs. We'll share individual driver names and mobile numbers by EOD Aug 3 once we finalize the roster.

2) Staging & curb policy: For Main HQ single-lane valet, we recommend a "3-minute pop" curb policy: drivers hold at the curb for maximum 3 minutes to unload guests; if exceeded, vehicle moves to Lot B and a relief driver brings the guest in from staging. For Satellite Loft, Lot B staging is 0.6 miles; our shuttle hop averages 4 minutes during AM peak. We propose a dedicated QR check-in that allows us to route a vehicle dynamically if flight is delayed (we'll provide the QR and a small driver tablet app).

3) EV availability: EV surcharge applies only if the client requires a specific EV model. Otherwise, EVs are available and we will prioritize charging windows overnight.

4) Rates & SOW: We will honor the previously quoted corporate rates for Aug 18–19 for the confirmed fleet, plus a 10% hold fee per backup vehicle (covers 4-hour warm hold). Draft SOW and DocuSign link sent as separate email to Jordan (to review and route).

5) Security & privacy: For executives who request privacy, we will assign single-driver vehicles and block ride-sharing. Drivers will be briefed on discrete pick-up/drop-off instructions and given a guest-level PII minimization checklist.

We are available for a 20-min ops call Tue 9:30am PT; Samir here can host.

—Samir Khatri
Ops Lead, BlueWing Car Services
samir.khatri@bluewingcars.com
+1 415-666-2042

Subject: Re: VIP kickoff: rental pool + last-mile SOP for hybrid workshop

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. Consolidating action items below and next steps. Please treat this as the source of truth for confirmations: 

Confirmed (so far):
- BlueWing: fleet + 4 warm backups; driver roster ETA EOD Aug 3 (Samir to send). Rates and SOW coming via DocuSign.
- Marissa: allocations tab updated.

Open items / owners:
- Karthik: please confirm preferred rental partner for the 4 backup cars and provide contact at that vendor by Aug 4 COB. If you want, use Acme's partner suggestion but confirm rates and hold policy.
- Lauren: please upload Satellite Loft curb map and Lot B GPS coordinates to the Drive folder and confirm 2-car hold lane measurements (width + clearance) by Aug 4 noon.
- BlueWing / Samir: please include the 24/7 dispatch number and a list of drivers (names + last 4 of license) in your roster. We will circle back with Security for vetting on Aug 5.

Operational decisions:
- We'll adopt BlueWing's "3-minute pop" curb policy at Main HQ and Lot B shuttle fallback for any overruns.
- Privacy: single-driver vehicles for flagged execs (Marissa will mark in manifest).

Final note: I sent the DocuSign SOW to BlueWing this afternoon — Samir, please review and approve so we can finalize billing and hold fees. If anyone expects additional attachments (e.g., signage art for curb), flag before Aug 6.

If there are no objections, I'll close planning and confirm vendor booking on Aug 6 EOD.

Jordan Blake
Program Lead, Events & Customer Ops
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192
